news.text: #Suzuki And #Juve At The Final Turn#Spalletti and the goalkeeper puzzleThree-way table with #Parma and #PSG: #Vicario waiting. Maneuvers for #Zirkzee and #Kessié. At 12 PM, the test against #Palermo.#Vlahovic Under #ItalianoDusan starts new from Turkiye: there is an agreement with #Besiktas. The blitz in Serbia by the Sporting Director Graf was decisive: a 48-hour summit for the white smoke. Between today and tomorrow the signature: a three-year contract at 8 million plus bonuses per year, plus another 20 immediately. He will reunite with the coach under whom he had scored 20 goals in Florence.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

"#JUVE, I'VE BEEN THINKING ABOUT YOU FOR A YEAR"#KoloMuani says it allThe French forward admits: "The difficult season at #Tottenham? I was... distracted by the desire to return here. This summer I realized that we would finally make it. #Juve is special, I am ready for anything for #Spalletti". A deal can be closed for #Suzuki and #Lucumí remains a possibility. The striker at the end of the mercato: #Sørloth holds form, for #Mateta it is tough.[Front Page TuttoSport]

If they were to purchase a new striker, #Juventus would have to find new places for both #David and #Milik. If the latter were not to leave (the option of a mutual contract termination has not completely faded, but it is not simple), the risk for the Pole is to remain excluded from the squad lists.[Mirko Nicolino]
🚨 Possible #Juventus lineup: Perin; Celik, Kelly, Kalulu, Cambiaso; Locatelli, Douglas Luiz; Conceicao, McKennie, Yildiz; David.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

Zion #Suzuki to #PSG from #Parma is at the final stage for €36M (bonuses included). Ready a contract until 2031. #Paris are confident to close in the next days after the positive meeting with Suzuki’s agent. #transfers[Nico Schira]
Gleison #Bremer’s release clause (€54M) now expired. The centre-back is ready to stay at #Juventus. #transfers[Nico Schira]

GJustjuve 🚨🇯🇵 Juventus are set to decide soon on Zion Suzuki’s loan move from Paris Saint-Germain, as soon as PSG will close the deal from Parma. 🔴🔵 PSG are closing in on €35m package to sign the Japanese GK from Parma, as revealed. Juve would get him on straight… https://t.me/GJustjuve/70969🇯🇵❗️"#Suzuki: #PSG and #Parma are in agreement for a figure of around €35M, the details on the fixed part and bonuses are missing, but it is being resolved. Now, #Juventus must give an answer in a very short time regarding the loan. He remains the favorite for the bianconero goal. The French club is waiting for the definitive green light or a potential rejection from la Vecchia Signora."[Fabrizio Romano

🇽🇰 "There is good news from the #Juventus tour: #Zhegrova trained for the first time 'very well', completing two consecutive high-intensity sessions.He impressed the coaching staff and #Spalletti, who praised him publicly in front of his teammates.This demonstrates a recovery of form that could turn into an extra weapon for #Juve.He should not be evaluated by the friendly matches because the players are doing double training sessions every day, the training feedback counts more."[@antoniocorsa on @twotalkstv via @PuebloJ]

🚨🇯🇵 Juventus are set to decide soon on Zion Suzuki’s loan move from Paris Saint-Germain, as soon as PSG will close the deal from Parma.🔴🔵 PSG are closing in on €35m package to sign the Japanese GK from Parma, as revealed.Juve would get him on straight loan. 🔂[Fabrizio Romano]

🇳🇱🆙 #Zirkzee is approaching #Juventus in small steps: #Rashford's reintegration accelerates the exit. #Carnevali is ready to offer a loan with an option to buy (#ManchesterUnited is no longer stonewalling on this formula), but he must first sell #David, who has rejected proposals from Turkiye and might say goodbye only for a prestigious club. #PSG and #AstonVilla have made some moves for him.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]
#Juventus are working to find a solution for Arek #Milik’s sale. The polish striker is not in Luciano #Spalletti’s Plans. #transfers[Nico Schira]

🤔🧤 #Suzuki remains a target for #Juventus, but so far there has been no contact with #PSG for the loan, nor with the goalkeeper. The #Vicario alternative: #Tottenham has not yet opened to a loan, but there are signs in that direction.[Sky Sport via @Juventus_Reborn]

🇫🇷🗣 #KoloMuani to La Stampa: “#Juventus is special: an iconic, respected club and with important values in Italy. Returning to Turin after my first experience was an honor and a logical choice for my career.”[@Juventus_Reborn]

🧤🧐 "There have been contacts with #Benfica for #Trubin. The request is €40M and #Juventus cannot reach that figure: this deal is considered too expensive. The bianconeri must wait for #PSG's final decision for #Suzuki: it was a working weekend, the French club is increasingly closer, but must formalize. In the meantime, la Vecchia Signora will have to decide whether to take him on loan. #Vicario remains in the background."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴🆙 "Between tomorrow and Thursday, new contacts are expected with #Bologna for #Lucumí. #Juventus has offered €17M, but it was not enough: the bianconeri could reach €18/20M, perhaps by inserting a % on a future resale + the loan with an option to buy for #Cabal to bring the Colombian to Turin, who already has a contract agreement with la Vecchia Signora (a five-year deal at €2.5M)."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
